newsitem.title: GERMANY: Zaire military meeting lays out options.
newsitem.headline: Zaire military meeting lays out options.

text.p: Western and African military officials said on Sunday they had developed options for missions to help refugees in Zaire ranging from a low level of assistance to an "increased level of protection and security" for humanitarian relief.

Lieutenant-General Maurice Baril of Canada, designated to lead any multinational force to help refugees in eastern Zaire, said a meeting of the military leaders agreed that as many as 250,000 refugees may still be in eastern Zaire.

"The mission of a multinational force, as we have defined it, would be to facilitate the delivery of humanitarian assistance and voluntary repatriation of refugees and displaced persons," Baril said told a news conference.
"The objectives of such a force would be strictly humanitarian. The force would be politically and militarily neutral."
He did not provide details about possible forces and said individual goverments must review the mission options.

The options include continuing to encourage current humanitarian assistance and establishing a multinational headquarters to direct humanitarian efforts. Another option calls for facilitating the efforts, while a fourth calls for using security forces to aid the efforts.
